title: Tax Estimate Estimated Liability Leaderboard
dataSources: TurboTax returns (`turbotax:return`), IRS transcripts (`irs:transcript`), tax estimates (`tax:estimate`), tax payments (`tax:payment`), and W-2 imports (`w2:import`).
app: TurboTax return exports, IRS transcript pulls, tax estimate calculators, payment confirmations, and W-2 import logs ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=tax:estimate estimated_liability_usd=*
| stats sum(estimated_liability_usd) as total_value, avg(estimated_liability_usd) as avg_value by tax_year
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks tax year values by total and average estimated liability across tax estimate events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `estimated_liability_usd` values for each tax estimate event and review total and average estimated liability by tax year.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total estimated liability.
grandmaExplanation: It celebrates which tax year shows the biggest estimated liability numbers in your tax estimate data.
